brief: The world mourns country legend Dolly Parton, whose bold style and songs broke barriers, while trade tensions escalate as Canada retaliates with high tariffs. In research, AI disclosure, explainability, and human-data interaction take center stage.
news_summary: Dolly Parton's death at 80 prompts tributes from stars and politicians, highlighting her impact on music and culture. Meanwhile, Canada imposes retaliatory tariffs up to 50% on US goods, escalating the trade war, and other global developments include measles deaths, military family deportations, and AI server smuggling charges.
papers_summary: Recent papers address AI disclosure in research, multi-persona AI for stance reflection, and AI guidance in assembly tasks. Other studies explore XAI selection problems, multi-agent dataset exploration, urban gaze visualization, data issue detection in AI-assisted visualization, and reflections on working with older adults in visualization research.
